ideas.title: Smart Campus Navigation & AR Wayfinding
ideas.problem: New students, guests, and visitors frequently get lost navigating between campus blocks, lecture halls, labs, and administrative offices across our 120-acre campus.
ideas.solution: Develop an interactive mobile-first web app with AR indoor/outdoor navigation, real-time classroom schedules, step-by-step route guidance, and wheelchair accessible paths.
ideas.impact: Helps 15,000+ campus students, faculty, and visiting guests save time, locate examination halls instantly, and improves accessibility campus-wide.

ideas.title: AI Peer Tutoring & Study Group Matcher
ideas.problem: Students struggle finding study partners and peer mentors tailored to their specific subject difficulties and available study slots.
ideas.solution: An intelligent recommendation engine matching students based on course syllabus, weakness topics, learning pace, and mutual calendar availability.
ideas.impact: Improves student pass rates and course mastery by 35% and fosters inclusive peer-to-peer campus learning communities.

ideas.title: Campus Eco-Cycle Zero-Waste Initiative
ideas.problem: Massive amounts of paper, plastic, and food waste are generated daily with insufficient recycling awareness and tracking metrics.
ideas.solution: Deploy IoT smart weight bins connected to a gamified reward dashboard where students scan QR codes for recycling and earn green campus credits.
ideas.impact: Diverts over 60% of recyclable campus waste from landfills and promotes sustainable habits among 10,000+ students.

ideas.title: Autonomous Campus Delivery Bot
ideas.problem: Inter-department document, lab sample, and library book transfer takes hours of manual staff transit time across large campus zones.
ideas.solution: Design miniature autonomous wheeled rovers using LIDAR and Computer Vision to safely transport books and lab kits across designated campus pathways.
ideas.impact: Saves 200+ staff hours weekly and provides a hands-on robotics testbed for engineering students.

discussions.title: Should we use Three.js WebGL or lightweight Canvas2D for indoor AR arrows?
discussions.content: We need high framerate on low-end budget smartphones while keeping battery usage minimal. Three.js gives smooth 3D depth, but Canvas2D has near-zero bundle footprint. Thoughts team?

replies.text: I ran a benchmark on mid-range Android devices. Three.js using a single lightweight arrow mesh achieved 60fps easily with under 12% CPU usage. Plus we can load models asynchronously.
Agreed with Sarah! The 3D depth perception from Three.js makes wayfinding much more intuitive than a flat 2D canvas arrow.

discussions.title: Color Palette & High Contrast Mode for Outdoor Sunlight Visibility
discussions.content: When walking in direct outdoor sun, subtle dark mode colors are hard to read. I have drafted an Ultra-Contrast mode with neon cyan (#00f2fe) path highlights and dark border stroke.

replies.text: Looks super crisp! Let’s add an auto-brightness/ambient light detector toggle so it switches seamlessly when stepping outdoors.
